subject: Executive attendance + recording preferences for NebulaOps demo
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nebulaops.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Executive attendance + recording preferences for NebulaOps demo

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the quick chat last week. We’re excited to run a tailored demo focused on the platform workloads you described. Before we lock a time I want to confirm two things so we can shape the agenda:

1) Executive presence — will either Markus Jahn (CTO) or Priya Patel (VP Eng) be joining for the first 20–30 minutes for an executive-level overview? If so, we’ll reserve the first half of the session for strategic alignment and ROI examples.

2) Recording policy — do you want this session recorded? We typically record demos for internal follow-up, but happy to disable recording if you prefer. If you want a recording, we can mark sensitive sections to be clipped.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed, Jan 25 — 10:00–10:45 AM
- Thu, Jan 26 — 2:00–2:45 PM

I’ve attached the 12‑slide MVP deck and the NDA we signed. If procurement needs a pricing/terms summary ahead of time, loop them in and we’ll send a short packet.

If either slot works, I’ll have David prep a 20-minute exec section + 20-minute technical walkthrough and Grace will send the invite with the desired meeting options.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: NebulaOps_MVP_Deck.pdf, NDA_signature.pdf

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nebulaops.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, procurement@nebulaops.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Executive attendance + recording preferences for NebulaOps demo

Thanks, Stephanie —

Both slots you proposed look doable. Our preference is Wed, Jan 25 at 10:00 AM PT. Markus (CTO) will join for the first 30 minutes; Priya (VP Eng) is traveling but may hop in for the Q&A.

Recording: we prefer that the live session is not recorded by default. If you want a recording for internal training, please hold off until we explicitly agree — there are a couple of IP-sensitive components in our environment we’d rather not capture.

Procurement: I’ve cc’d our procurement mailbox. They will want a one-pager with standard pricing bands and any enterprise addendum highlights before the meeting. If you can share that by EOD Tue, that would be ideal.

Looking forward — please confirm final invite and agenda.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Platform, NebulaOps
laura.chen@nebulaops.com
+1 206 555 0126

Great — Wed 1/25 10:00 AM PT is confirmed tentatively.

David: can you own the first 20–25 minutes tailored to Markus (CTO) — top-level performance/cost story + two quick customer case studies? Keep the technical deep-dive ready in case Priya joins later.

Grace: please send a calendar invite for Jan 25 10:00–10:45 AM PT with a single join link. Per Laura, recording should be disabled by default; add a short note in the invite that no recording will be made without express permission.

Procurement: we’ll get a one-page pricing summary to you by EOD Tue (attached here in draft). David — I’ll pull the price band slide and drop it into a two-slide packet for procurement.

Laura — thanks for the preference note. We’ll disable recording and will only enable it if you explicitly approve after the session.

Stephanie

Subject: NebulaOps demo — final invite and agenda (Wed Jan 25, 10:00 AM PT)

Hi all —

Invite sent: Wed, Jan 25 • 10:00–10:45 AM PT (Zoom link included). I attached a short agenda (one page) — exec overview (20m), platform demo (20m), live Q&A (5m).

Recording: per Laura’s request, recording is disabled for the meeting. If NebulaOps asks post-demo for a recording, we will extract clips and share only with explicit written permission.

Procurement: draft pricing packet attached; Stephanie & David will finalize the one-pager by EOD today. If procurement has specific contract language items, please flag them in reply and we’ll prep for the demo follow-up.

Logistics notes for our side (internal):
- David: please highlight the batch/kv-cache savings example at ~slide 4 and prepare the cost-per-100k-tokens number.
- Stephanie: I’ll include an optional 15-minute deep-dive link in the invite for post-demo follow-up.

See you Wed.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0167

Attachments: Agenda.pdf
